title: M.T Pockets Theatre Spooks & Sparkles Halloween Pageant
description:
Date: October 17, 2026
Time: Registration 10:00 AM, Pageant 11:00 AM
Event Address: Clinton District Volunteer Fire Department, 1989 Grafton Road, Morgantown, WV 26508
Thank you for your interest in the 2026 M.T. Pockets Theatre Spooks & Sparkles Halloween Pageant (“Pageant”)! Please complete and submit this application and pay your fee to secure your spot. This Pageant will take place on October 17, 2026 at Clinton District Volunteer Fire Department, 1989 Grafton Road, Morgantown, WV 27508. All applications and entry fees are due by midnight on October 10, 2026. After registration closes, a welcome letter will be sent with detailed information for pageant day. Please also feel free to reach out to the director, Haley Hillen, with any questions at mtpocketstheatrepageants@gmail.com or on the MT Pockets Theatre Pageants Facebook page.
 ABOUT M.T. POCKETS THEATRE, INC.
This Pageant is a fundraiser for M.T. Pockets Theatre, Inc.  M. T. Pockets Theatre is a 501(c)3 NPO. Its mission is to enhance the theatre community in Morgantown, West Virginia and surrounding regions by presenting live performances of classic, contemporary and new works that promote women and minorities in the arts; provide a venue for alternative theatre that addresses contemporary and sensitive issues through performance; provide a venue for new works and support the work of emerging playwrights and artists without bias; and to theatre accessible to those whom otherwise might not have the opportunity to experience live theatre due to physical, financial or geographical limitations. All funds raised by this Pageant will go towards this mission.
REQUIRED EVENT
Main Event $50
The main titles for this pageant will be determined by one event, which is Halloween Costume! The contestant will walk on the stage to provided music in their costume, which can be anything you choose, as long as it is not offensive or inappropriate as this is a family friendly event. Attire must be age-appropriate.  Also, please no masks, as the judges want to see your lovely faces! Finally, no props that are weapons will be permitted so as to not make any attendee uncomfortable. If you have a question about a costume or prop, please reach out to the director, as violation of these rules may result in point deductions or, in extreme cases, expulsion without refund from the pageant. The walk does not have to be a traditional pageant walk, and contestants are encouraged to model their costume in character. Have fun with it!
This pageant is a crown all, meaning every contestant will be recognized during crowning and will receive a crown, sash and gift! Higher titles will receive different crowns and gifts, but no contestant will go home empty-handed. Every age group for the girls will have a Halloween Queen and a Princess Court.  The boys will have their own group with a Halloween King and a Prince Court. The groups are as follows:
0-12 months
1-3 Years
4-5 Years
6-8 Years
9-15 Years
15-25 Years
26+ Years
Boys of all ages
Additionally, we will crown the following Supremes:
2 Spook Supremes: Ages 0-7 years and Ages 8+ years
2 Sparkle Supremes: Ages 0-7 years and Ages 8+ years
2 Grand Supremes: Ages 0-7 years and Ages 8+ years
 1 Ultimate Grand Halloween Supreme: The highest score for the whole pageant
*The director reserves the right to combine, eliminate, or modify groups based on contestant numbers.
There will be a $5 family discount for each additional family member that competes (Ex 1:Mom and daughter enter = $50 for Mom + $45 for daughter. Ex 2: 3 siblings enter = $50 for first sibling + $45 for second sibling + $45 for third sibling)
OPTIONAL EVENTS
1. Themewear: SPARKLES! $10
 For this optional event, contestants may dress as anything sparkles! Dress in something sparkly and fun, or wear a gorgeous gown and practice your beauty walk! We want to see you sparkle!
This is an OPTIONAL event and does NOT affect scores for the main pageant. You MUST enter the Main Event in order to enter this optional event.  We will provide music. Winner will receive a sash and crown, as well as a gift. The following titles may be won for this event:
Sparkle Princess  0-7 Years
Sparkle Queen  7+ Years
Sparkle King       Boys of all ages
*We reserve the right to combine or eliminate groups based on entry numbers
2. Talent $10
We love celebrating the talent of our community! Showcase any talent for a chance at one of the talent titles. This is an OPTIONAL event and does NOT affect scores for the main pageant. You MUST enter the Main Event in order to enter this optional event. You will be required to provide anything you need to perform your talent (music, props, etc.). The type of talent must be provided prior to the Pageant, and M.T. Pockets reserves the right to deny entries or require changes should it deem the talent to present an unsafe, inappropriate, offensive, or overly messy situation. 
The following titles may be won for this event:
MT Pockets Theatre Junior Royal Talent         0-7 Years
MT Pockets Theatre Royal Talent                    8+ Years
*We reserve the right to combine or eliminate groups based on entry numbers
3. Photogenic $5 per entry
Contestants may enter as many photographs as they wish at $5 per photograph. The judges will select the overall photogenic winner, who will receive an award. You MUST bring a printed photo to submit the day of. It will be return f after the pageant. This is an OPTIONAL event and does NOT affect scores for the main pageant. You MUST enter the Main Event in order to enter this optional event. 
You may also bring additional photos to the pageant with the corresponding fee if you decide to enter the photogenic optional after submitting this application.
4. Fan Favorite
Contestants may seek the title of Fan Favorite, who will receive a large crown, sash, and gift. Fan Favorite is a fundraising title in which the contestants can collect funds to support the theatre. Each $1 counts as one vote. A contestant can raise funds and turn them in at the Pageant and friends and family can also vote for the contestant by making donations in their name. These funds should NOT be paid with the pageant entry fees but separately the day of the pageant, or via separately submitted donations prior to the pageant. If votes are submitted prior to the pageant, please inform Haley Hillen so that she can confirm and ensure they are counted.
OTHER INFORMATION
We would love a full audience to cheer for our fabulous contestants! There will be a $5 entry fee for spectators (contestants are free). We strive to provide a space where everyone feels comfortable and respected. As such, bad sportsmanship or bullying will NOT be tolerated. If any such incident is reported it will immediately be investigated and, if proven true, the offending contestant will be immediately disqualified without refund and asked to leave the premises.  Any spectators, parents/guardians, or other persons displaying bad sportsmanship or bullying will also be asked to leave the premises without refund. 
Concessions will be available for purchase.
